title: 🪟 The November 2026 update for Windows 11 — a new menu, cloud rebuild and a stronger magnifier!
body: 🪟 The November 2026 update for Windows 11 — a new menu, cloud rebuild and a stronger magnifier!

Microsoft has launched the November 2026 update for Windows 11, bringing improvements to File Explorer, system recovery and accessibility features, in an update that has been reaching devices gradually during the week.

The update offers a redesigned right-click menu with wider customisation options, and a new feature called "Cloud Rebuild" that lets you reinstall the system using files downloaded from the Windows Update service, instead of relying on a copy saved on the device itself.

The update also improves the Magnifier tool to work better across multiple screens, and develops Live Captions and Narrator to help users follow audio and text on screen, along with changes to Xbox mode, Settings and Phone Link.

Simply put: an update that makes repairing the system easier from the cloud, and helps those who find reading or seeing difficult. Will the update reach your computer automatically, or do you prefer to install it yourself?
